en: Black‑and‑white view of a tree‑lined residential street with large bourgeois villas on the right side, built in an ornate historicist style with timber‑framing in the gables, steep tiled roofs, turrets, balconies, and wooden verandas. A stone wall separates the houses from the sidewalk. The scene is quiet with no visible cars, suggesting an early 20th‑century European suburb. No printed title or caption is visible on the image side.
